🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; Technology the lone clear outlier (weak). Confirmations: broad sector leadership outside Tech (Communication, Staples, Energy) and a major divergence with multiple Big Tech names BELOW TREND (MSFT, NVDA, AMD), plus Top-5 leadership concentrated (Narrow: 3/5 Communication).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads: CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.63% | 1M: +6.75%), VZ ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.28% | 1M: +18.88%), T ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.09% | 1M: +11.45%). Consumer Staples strong: PEP ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +18.77%), TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.18% | 1M: +11.78%), CL ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.02% | 1M: +23.42%). Energy showing lift: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +17.73%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +10.61%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -7.40%), AMAT CORRECTION (1W: -11.63% | 1M: +4.67%). Financials mixed/soft: JPM RECOVERY (1W: +5.49% | 1M: -4.59%), V RECOVERY (1W: +0.91% | 1M: -6.74%), PYPL BELOW TREND (1W: -24.13% | 1M: -30.80%). Consumer Discretionary internally rotating with TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -10.11%) and HD ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.17% | 1M: +12.53%).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.63% | 1M: +6.75%), VZ ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.28% | 1M: +18.88%), DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.63% | 1M: +30.12%), FDX ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.22% | 1M: +21.88%), T ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.09% | 1M: +11.45%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Communication) — selectivity warranted.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -10.64% | 1M: -8.46%), NEM CORRECTION (1W: -11.44% | 1M: +12.87%), AMAT CORRECTION (1W: -11.63% | 1M: +4.67%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -12.51% | 1M: -22.17%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%). Weakness concentrated in Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves: CHTR (1W: +22.63%), VZ (1W: +19.28%), DOW (1W: +16.63%), FDX (1W: +15.22%), UPS (1W: +12.57%). Watch major divergence: several mega-cap tech names (MSFT, NVDA, AMD) are moving opposite the broad sector-positive market — tactical risk.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech in clear weakness/rotation: AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.82% | 1M: +3.45%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -7.40%), GOOGL CORRECTION (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +5.21%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +1.55%). Sector-level risk persists despite pockets of strength in select large caps.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials showing patchy recovery: JPM RECOVERY (1W: +5.49% | 1M: -4.59%), MA RECOVERY (1W: +6.17% | 1M: -2.50%), V RECOVERY (1W: +0.91% | 1M: -6.74%), PYPL BELOW TREND (1W: -24.13% | 1M: -30.80%). Breadth moderate within Financials; style: Value/cyclical cues present but fragmented.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare constructive overall: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.96% | 1M: +14.76%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.14% | 1M: +6.30%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -19.33%). New approvals and M&A chatter supporting select names while some large caps face idiosyncratic regulatory risk.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
NEUTRAL regime — favor exposure to leadership sectors (Communication, Staples, Energy) and favor names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND performance (CHTR, VZ, PEP, XOM). Reduce exposure to the weakest Technology names (MSFT, NVDA, AMD) until trend confirmation; be selective given narrow leadership and major tech divergence.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: JNJ (1W: +2.96% | 1M: +14.76%) — sentiment +75 and price ABOVE TREND confirming; LLY (1W: +8.14% | 1M: +6.30%) — sentiment +65 and price ABOVE TREND; BA (1W: -2.33% | 1M: +3.43%) — sentiment +60 but short-term CORRECTION to monitor. BEARISH: UNH (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -19.33%) — sentiment -80 and price BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -10.64% | 1M: -8.46%) — sentiment -55 and price BELOW TREND; QCOM (trend not listed here) flagged by news (-50) — monitor for spillover.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (1W: +9.02%) — strong momentum and concentrated leadership. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -6.87%) — continued downside in megacaps could slow market upside.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch AAPL reclaiming its 1M uptrend confirmation (AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.82% | 1M: +3.45%)); NVDA needs to stabilize above recent 1W highs to remove CORRECTION pressure (NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -7.40%)); MSFT break of short-term support would reinforce Tech risk (MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -14.00% | 1M: -12.41%)); JPM continuation above recent 1W lift would cement RECOVERY (JPM RECOVERY (1W: +5.49% | 1M: -4.59%)).

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+75): New approvals and oncology push; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.96% | 1M: +14.76%) — sentiment confirming price action. LLY (+65): Strong profit flow; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.14% | 1M: +6.30%) — confirming accumulation. RTX (+60): Pentagon deals; RTX (trend not detailed here) but sector momentum supports Industrials — watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-80): DOJ probe headlines; UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -19.33%) — sentiment and price confirm downside risk. ABT (-80): Recall headlines; ABT (trend not provided here) — monitor for volatility. ACN (-55): Institutional selling noted; ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -10.64% | 1M: -8.46%) — sentiment confirming distribution.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with a Value/Recovery tilt given leadership in Communication, Staples and Energy. CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.63% | 1M: +6.75%), VZ ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.28% | 1M: +18.88%) and XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +17.73%) are showing relative strength. Key risk is narrow leadership and major Tech divergence (MSFT, NVDA, AMD BELOW TREND) amplified by negative headlines on UNH and ACN.
